raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the 1989 handmade/test-run release of the original Icehouse sets with “Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set,” incorrectly stating the Martian Chess Set as the first release in 1989. In reality, the Martian Chess Set product was released in 1999 (as shown on the BGG page), while the 1989 date refers to early Icehouse sets. This misattribution shows the Planner did not verify the specific edition/year and mixed two different releases.
